description: Gemini single feedback prompt for reference-audio vs user-audio speaking evaluation
notes: Adopts the Quickfire-style structured prompt layout with separate system and user sections. This is the only single_feedback prompt copy: the legacy unversioned prompts/single_feedback/ duplicate was merged into v1 and removed on 2026-10-15, so GEMINI_PROMPT_VERSION=v1 now loads everything.

changelog.changes: Require every omission or substitution to carry a Chinese gloss in the `English (中文意思)` form and to explain its role in the sentence, so completeness feedback cannot stop at a generic 'changed the vocabulary' summary.

Reorder the evaluation around the learner's priorities: accuracy/completeness is now first and highest priority, fluently covers pauses/filler words/thought-group segmentation, and pronunciation only lists specific words with IPA. Completeness may use 1-3 sentences and must locate each omission and explain what the missing part means; suggestions may now cover up to one item per dimension (max 3), prioritizing accuracy.

Restore the three-dimension evaluation as a first-class output: pronunciation / completeness / fluency each carry one sentence and stay scoped to their own dimension, and every suggestion now declares a `dimension` so the UI can attach advice to the matching evaluation. Also fixes the issues schema example (empty array) and the numbering gap in user.md.
Make pronunciation feedback conservative around word stress and accent variants; return only concise actionable suggestions and keep issues empty to avoid duplicated problem/advice lists.

Require all feedback fields (pronunciation / completeness / fluency / issues.problem / suggestions.text) to be written in Chinese, while transcription_text and target_word stay in original English; Chinese-annotate the JSON schema so English placeholders no longer leak into feedback. Also merges the previously inactive prompts/single_feedback/ revision: multimodal role wording, Gemini-owned display transcription, clarified issue-point timestamp semantics, and a hard ban on word-level / segment-level transcription timestamps.
Migrate from single txt prompt to structured system.md + user.md + metadata.json layout.
